entities.summary: Fujiwara no Toshinari or Shunzei  was a Japanese poet, courtier, and Buddhist monk of the late Heian period. He was also known by his monastic name Shakua (釈阿) and when younger (1123–67) as Akihiro (顕広). He was noted for his innovations in the waka poetic form and compiling the Senzai Wakashū, the seventh imperial anthology of waka poetry.
